result = Box(plate_length, plate_width, plate_thickness)

        SlotOverall(slot_length, slot_width)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    for j in range(hole_rows):

        y = (j - (hole_rows-1)/2) * hole_spacing_y
        hole = Pos(x, y, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, plate_thickness + 10)

    angle_rad = math.radians(angle_deg)
    px = slot_radius * math.cos(angle_rad)

    slot = Pos(px, py, thickness / 2 + boss_height / 2) * Rot(0, 0, angle_deg) * Box(slot_width, slot_depth, boss_height)
    result = result - slot

part = result
part.name = "flanged_disc_with_slots"
export_step(part, "output.step")
